patients.label: Gravida 3 woman aged 38 years admitted with pelvic pain, diarrhea and oral lesions, with a severe adverse event after low-dose MTX
attribution_limitations: The ectopic pregnancy and the methotrexate indication are stated only in the abstract sentence about the presented case; the case paragraph gives a 2-cm gestational sac in the right fallopian tube and tubal rupture without diagnosis wording. The side of the salpingectomy is not stated.

The first sentence says the patient was admitted with pelvic pain, diarrhea and oral lesions, but the narrative later describes a readmission with bloody diarrhea, oral lesions and macular rash; it is not stated whether the first sentence describes the first admission or the readmission.

The text says "the second day" for readmission after discharge on the first postoperative day without naming the anchor; creatinine 1.76 mg/dL is reported without a flag while the discussion says the patient had no renal insufficiency.

Table 1 is an image-only table (blood count rows labelled Admission day, 1st day, 2nd day, 3rd day, 4th day and 10th day with Hb, WBC and PLT). Its printed values are pixel content recorded in visual.json only; the text values Hb 6.4 and 6.2 gr/dL and WBC 2000 and 1600 /µL are the only table-consistent text facts.
Glucarpidase is mentioned only as unavailable in Turkey, as the reason plasmapheresis was considered; the source does not state for this patient that it was not given.
